# Siray Tech
> Siray Tech (siraytech.co.za) sells tested pre-owned and brand-new gaming PCs, laptops, graphics cards, monitors, storage and peripherals from Laudium, Centurion (Gauteng), with courier delivery anywhere in South Africa. A division of Compuspare.

## Key facts
- Location: Laudium, Centurion, Gauteng, South Africa (collection by appointment; address shared once a collection is booked)
- Delivery: courier nationwide, R60 to R350 depending on the item
- Pre-owned stock: every item is cleaned, tested and shown working before payment
- Custom builds: specified to your games and budget, built in 3 to 4 business days
- Trade-ins: old PCs, graphics cards, consoles and phones can be sold or traded in against an upgrade
- Payment: EFT, full payment confirms the order
- Contact: WhatsApp 073 678 6392, siraytech@gmail.com, Instagram @siraytech
